lines: i was messing with the trail photo. i opened something. a void.
You wake in the driver seat. Same road. Wrong color. The phone is dead. Mom’s house is ahead. Every window is dark. You put the car in the garage. It doesn’t turn over.
Mom is in the passenger seat. She doesn’t ask what you saw. The camera is face-down on the dash.
Mom is in the passenger seat. She does not look up.
Ben, on the trail. Something in the background is wrong.

itemDesc.stick: Still taped from the game. Quiet, until the tape gives.
itemDesc.knife: Short, sharp, and not going to last.
itemDesc.pistol: Loud enough to call the whole house. The street is not there to hear it.
itemDesc.ammo: Not many. Spending one should mean something.
itemDesc.pills: The date on the bottle is fine. Everything else is not.
itemDesc.film: One exposure. The garage bench can pin a room in place. There are not many.
itemDesc.tape: Wrap the hockey stick before it gives up.
itemDesc.key-her: From the bathroom cabinet. It fits her door, off the hall.
itemDesc.key-base: Warm from the sweater pocket. The basement door is in the mudroom.
itemDesc.key-shed: A ring with the name scratched off. The shed is in the yard.
itemDesc.key-car: Yours. She had them again. They go in the ignition.
itemDesc.fuse: The garage door motor is dead without it. Seat it in the car.
itemDesc.gas: Heavy. The gauge was on E. So is everything else.
itemDesc.camera: The bulbs stun. The plate in the back is for the car — not the face.
